plan.motivation: One fixed quadratic recovery hypothesis selected from state-feedback analysis; no measured bimolecular reaction claim.

plan.score: Mean squared log10 current residual over original500 points including conditional anchor; no point removal.
plan.optimizer: One Nelder-Mead run from lowest full500 seed MSE; maximum80 function evaluations/iterations, no restarts.
plan.domain: lambda in[0,2]; each log coefficient within ln100 of selected seed. Finite exploration, not physical bounds.
plan.initial_simplex: Selected seed plus .1 in lambda (inward at upper boundary), plus .25 in each log coefficient.
plan.invalid_trials: Outside declared parameter domain returns infinity, serialized null with status; no clipping or finite fake residual.
plan.failure_policy: All numerical failures retain parameters, last RHS and available arrays; not physical rejections.
plan.timeout_policy: Any trajectory timeout stops entire search immediately; no optimizer restart. Existing best may enter reserved final validation.
plan.budget_start: After inputs/hashes and plan persistence; includes circuit checks, search and final verification.
plan.circuit_check: 36 predefined states/commands versus old42-bisection; select fast only if all tolerances pass, otherwise validated strict_bisection42.
plan.nearzero: Existing local Lorentz-area omission bound below1e-12; not a global solution error or zero-field retention prediction.
plan.physical_clock: Cumulative command voltage, not measured seconds
plan.limitations: Fixed m2 is an additional structural hypothesis; three actual fitted parameters and same-cycle data. Lower error is not independent validation or microscopic identification.
